rules: Use one big, instantly readable workplace or career scene as the full-bleed background, such as a hospital corridor, trading floor, commuter staircase, empty cubicle farm or office party
Keep the setting realistic and stock-photo-like, with desaturated, slightly cool or neutral tones so the text and one accent colour dominate
Headline is stacked in 2-3 centred lines of heavy white sans-serif caps with a thick black outline and drop shadow
Highlight exactly one key word or number per headline in neon yellow, such as a dollar figure, 'YEAR', 'IN PERSON' or 'FUN'
Frame the headline as a punchy concept phrase, such as 'THE INTELLECTUAL CEILING' or 'THE END OF THE 40 YEAR CAREER', rather than repeating the video title
Show people small or from behind in the environment, so the scale of the system is the story; use a single lonely figure for isolation or a crowd for conformity
Use depth cues such as blurred foreground or background, leading lines, rows of monitors and repeating cubicles to guide the eye toward the text block
Keep the emotional cue ironic and critical: isolation, grind, forced cheer or corporate absurdity
Darken or blur areas behind the text for contrast, and leave the central 60% of the frame free for the headline
Optional accent: a red brush-stroke swipe behind a word, or a faint grid background, for explainer-style emphasis, but never more than one graphic accent

textRules.font: Ultra-bold geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black / Impact-style) with thick black stroke and drop shadow; white with one neon yellow highlight word

composition: Full-bleed 16:9 photographic scene with a centred, stacked text zone across the middle third. The environment is shot with strong perspective lines (corridor, staircase, rows of desks or monitors) converging toward the centre. Subjects sit off-centre, left or right, or are small within the scene, with the centre kept visually calm and slightly darkened or blurred for text overlay.
subject: Anonymous workers or silhouettes in a corporate, medical or office environment (scrubs, shirt and tie, commuters, cubicles, trading screens), shown from behind, at a distance or with faces turned away, expressing isolation, grind or forced enthusiasm
promptTemplate: Photorealistic wide 16:9 stock-style photograph about {topic}. Scene: {subject}, in a realistic workplace or urban environment, shot with strong converging perspective lines and shallow depth of field. Anonymous figures seen from behind, in silhouette or at a distance, with no identifiable faces. Muted, slightly desaturated palette of cool blues, greys and warm beige, with moody overhead lighting. Leave the central horizontal band of the image relatively clean, darker and softly blurred to allow a large headline overlay. High contrast, sharp subject, cinematic documentary look. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks, no real or recognizable people.
